Name: TANK_WHEEL_PARAM
Description: Defines the wheels and suspension of tank legs.

Fields.Name: Attachment Position (X)
Fields.Description: X position where the wheel is attached. In metres.

Fields.Name: Attachment Position (Y)
Fields.Description: Y position where the wheel is attached. In metres.

Fields.Name: Attachment Position (Z)
Fields.Description: Z position where the wheel is attached. In metres.

Fields.Name: Wheel Radius
Fields.Description: The radius of the wheel. In metres.

Fields.Name: Suspension Length
Fields.Description: The length of the suspension. In metres.

Fields.Name: Rebound Strength
Fields.Description: How strongly the spring tries to return to its original length when compressed.

Fields.Name: Retraction Strength
Fields.Description: How strongly the spring tries to return to its original length when stretched.
